name: cadcraft
description: CAD drafting: CADCraft, an open-source AutoCAD-style program (command line, object snaps, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks, DXF/DWG). LOKI's agents draw real plans and parts with it over MCP ("draw a 6 x 4 m room with a door and dimension it") and export DXF, PNG, SVG or PDF. Runs on this computer; nothing is uploaded.
license: MIT OR Apache-2.0 (separate program; LOKI drives cadcraft-cli)
install: python tools/setup_extras.py cadcraft   (the official release build, checksum-checked)
